note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Peru: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A domiciled individual's labour income (pay and independent services) is taxed at 8% up to 5 tax units (UIT), 14% to 20, 17% to 35, 20% to 45 and 30% above, after the first seven UIT are exempt (plus up to three UIT of qualifying expenses); the 2026 UIT is PEN 5,500. There is no regional income tax.
figures.applies: Tax year 2026; PEN bands are the UIT bands times PEN 5,500.

sources.said: Bracket Reference in tax units * Tax rate (%) First Up to 5 8 Second 5 to 20 14 Third 20 to 35 17 Fourth 35 to 45 20 Fifth Over 45 30 * For 2026, a tax unit is equivalent to 5,500 Peruvian soles (PEN). The first seven tax units are exempted from tax, and, provided that certain requirements are met, individuals may deduct three additional tax units on expenses related to the lease of immovable property, independent professio

figures.finding: The tax year is the calendar year, without exception; the annual return is due within three months of its end (by SUNAT's schedule in March-April).

sources.said: Tax year: The tax year is the calendar year (there are no exceptions).
Filing and payment: An annual income tax return must be filed within three months of the end of the tax year.

figures.finding: The employer pays 9% of pay for health (EsSalud); the employee has 13% withheld for the National Pension System or about 12.5% for a private fund.

sources.said: Employers are obligated to make monthly health contribution payments equal to 9% of the total compensation paid to the employee.
Employers must apply monthly withholdings for pension funds contributions equal to (i) 13% of the compensation received by the employee in cases where the employee is affiliated with the Nat

figures.finding: The employer withholds monthly on the annual scale; a Peruvian payer withholds 8% from a resident individual's service fee.
figures.applies: 2026; the receipt threshold below which no 8% is withheld was not read.

sources.said: withholding tax applies to fees for technical services paid to a resident individual.

figures.finding: A non-domiciled individual pays a flat 30% on gross Peruvian-source pay with no deductions; royalties to a non-resident bear 30%.
figures.applies: No separate artiste rule was read.

sources.said: Income tax on non-domiciled employees is imposed at a flat rate of 30% on their gross Peruvian-source income. No deductions or credits apply to non-domiciled individuals.
Royalties paid by a Peruvian resident to a nonresident are considered Peruvian-source income and are subject to a 30%

figures.finding: Royalties paid to a resident individual have 6.25% withheld on the net after a 20% deduction, 5% of the gross.

sources.said: Royalty payments made to a resident individual are subject to a 6.25% withholding tax rate that is applied to the net income determined by applying a 20% discount to the gross income, for an effective rate of 5% of the gross income.

figures.finding: IGV (VAT) is 18% in general; it reaches a service only where its income is third-category (business) income, so a freelancer's fourth-category fee bears none.
figures.applies: An individual's independent work (fourth category); a worker who organises the activity as a business earns third-category income, which bears IGV. Read 2026-11-03.

sources.said: The general rate of VAT is 18%.
Toda prestación que una persona realiza para otra y por la cual percibe una retribución o ingreso que se considere renta de tercera categoría para los efectos del Impuesto a la Renta

figures.finding: Whoever pays a non-domiciled person Peruvian-source income withholds the income tax as a final tax and pays it monthly; a live show with non-domiciled artistes as its main performers bears 15% when paid to a non-domiciled company, and other income 30%.
figures.applies: 2026; the 15% and 30% are the companies' rates on SUNAT's page; an individual artiste's own rate is the blocker.

sources.said: Las personas o entidades que paguen a no domiciliados rentas de fuente peruana de cualquier naturaleza, deberán retener y abonar al fisco con carácter definitivo dentro de los plazos previstos por el Código Tributario para las obligaciones de periodicidad mensual el impuesto a la renta
Espectáculos en vivo con la participación principal de artistas intérpretes y ejecutantes no domiciliados: (15%) … Otras rentas: (30%)

figures.finding: A non-domiciled individual pays 30% on Peruvian work income and royalties; the 15% rate is for artists' live shows in Peru only, so a screen performer's pay bears 30%.
figures.applies: Non-domiciled individuals (art. 54); filmed work is not a live show
